headline: LivaNova Beats Q3 Earnings Estimates and Tops Revenue Expectations
summary: LivaNova PLC reported third-quarter results that beat analyst earnings estimates by $0.17 and topped revenue expectations.
why: Medical technology companies rely heavily on innovation pipelines and procedural volumes, with quarterly revenue and earnings beats serving as key catalysts for healthcare sector valuations.

impacts.name: LivaNova PLC
impacts.why: Beating both earnings and revenue estimates indicates strong commercial execution.
